text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon, I receive a notification
on my
phone, and just as I'm about to
look at it...
I've found the cleat!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hold up! Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Something rams into me from behind at
incredible
speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! I'm so sorry for tackling you,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Forgive her! Bakushin O's heart of justice
was
burning with passion at the thought
of catching a
criminal!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Somebody stole one of my classmate's
cleats! As
class rep, I couldn't overlook
it!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
These kinds of incidents keep happening
all over
the academy... I too, as a hero of
justice, am in
hot pursuit of the
perpetrator!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The most dastardly ne'er-do-well! A
crow!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, no! That's not it! Your cellphone just
looked
like the stolen cleat for a second!
choice_data_list: Did I just get mistaken for a crow...?
Did they mistake me for a crow...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I was so caught up in the moment, I even
forgot
that the criminal was a crow!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But next time, I'll be certain to get the
cleat back
from that naughty bird!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: CAW! CAW!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
There it is! It's got the cleat in its mouth
and
everything! This time, I swear on my
title as class
representative...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'm not letting you get away!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just the cleat, huh? This is the
card game
that went missing too!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Ah! My shoe hammer! The crow took it!
Thank
goodness it's back!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That crow is the master thief behind all
the thefts
at the academy! Great job,
Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Heh heh! Right!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This is a show of my Bakushin-fueled
class
representative prowess!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text:
I'd expect no less of our Baku! That's our
class rep
for you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O's fame grows even
greater!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Thank you class rep! You got my
cleat
back!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That crow will think twice before
straying from
the straight and narrow
again! With this, we have
protected the
academy's peace!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And if it does act up again, then my
rapid
legwork will set it straight as many
times as need
be!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, feel free to keep relying on
me in the
future!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The whole class is in an uproar over
Sakura
Bakushin O's impressive
achievements.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Agh?! Flying is totally unfair!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I let it get away. I'll have to work
on my
Bakushin more...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But backing down now would only bring
shame to
my title of class representative!
What should I
do?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inspired by how she mistook my
cellphone for a
cleat, we use it as a
decoy.
choice_data_list: Let's lure them out with a decoy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: GOT IT!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Thank you, Class Rep! You got my
cleat
back!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That crow will think twice before
straying from
the straight and narrow
again! With this, we have
protected the
academy's peace!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm the one who should thank you
all! I
learned a valuable lesson!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's not enough to just rely on my
Bakushin... It's
also important to devise a
strategy sometimes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears she made a breakthrough
while looking
for a solution to the
problem.
